sources.support: Jin Sung-Il and Pak Jin-Song allegedly used multiple aliases, U.S.-hosted laptops, AnyDesk/TeamViewer, staffing companies, and payment-platform accounts
sources.locator: Press release — allegations, named subjects, organizations, and scheme summary

sources.quote: The Justice Department today announced the indictment of North Korean nationals Jin Sung-Il (진성일) and Pak Jin-Song (박진성)

notes: Officially reported identity in a charged case; not an adjudication of guilt.
This is an indictment- and FBI-attributed persona, not a separate verified civil identity.

sources.quote: PAK JIN-SONG, EMANUEL ASHTOR, and their co-conspirators registered U.S. companies, including Taggcar Inc. and Vali Tech Inc.

notes: Collective indictment allegation. It does not establish that Pak was an officer, owner, or registrant of either company.

value.conduct: allegedly remotely accessed employer-provided laptops and executed commands without authorization

sources.quote: enabled the co-conspirators, including JIN SUNG-IL and PAK JIN-SONG, to remotely access victim laptops by turning them on, logging in, installing software, and executing other commands on such devices without authorization.

notes: Indictment allegation; employer and device selectors are not retained.

sources.quote: On or about March 23, 2022, PAK JIN-SONG was hired for a position as a mobile application developer for services ultimately rendered by Company A utilizing the "Glaus Li" persona

notes: Indictment allegation; the employer label and address were excluded.

sources.locator: PDF file page 16 (printed p. 15), continuation of paragraph 10
sources.quote: installed Anydesk on the Company A laptop, enabling PAK JIN-SONG, to perform remote IT work using the "Glaus Li" persona.

notes: The indictment directly links AnyDesk to Pak's alleged work. Its later TeamViewer allegation concerns Jin Sung-Il, not Pak.

sources.quote: PAK JIN-SONG, utilizing the "Glaus Li" persona, applied for a specialist engineer position

notes: Indictment allegation; staffing firm, employer, address, and identity-document details were excluded.

sources.quote: PAK JIN-SONG, utilizing the "Glaus Li" persona, applied for a position as a mobile application developer

notes: Indictment allegation; employer, recruiter, address, and contact selectors were excluded.

sources.quote: All five defendants are charged with conspiracy to cause damage to a protected computer, conspiracy to commit wire fraud and mail fraud, conspiracy to commit money laundering, and conspiracy to transfer false identification documents.
Jin and Pak are charged with conspiracy to violate the International Emergency Economic Powers Act.

notes: Charges are allegations; Pak Jin-Song is presumed innocent unless and until proven guilty.

sources.quote: Pak Jin-Song is wanted for his alleged involvement in a fraudulent scheme to obtain remote information technology (IT) work with U.S. companies that generated revenue for the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK).
